Q: Extract substring in excel cell A:

With regular expression use this formula in cell C1 and dragdown

=REGEXEXTRACT(A1,"(?<="&B1&":)[^ |\s]+")

Input Condition Result
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange A Red
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange B Blue
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange C Orange

If empty Condition value is possible, test the value in column B.

=IF(B1<>"",REGEXEXTRACT(A1,"(?<="&B1&":)[^ |\s]+"),"")

Input Condition Result
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange A Red
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange B Blue
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange C Orange
A:Red B:Blue C:Orange

Q: Custom Position Sizes with Pine and WunderTrading A:

The command strategy.entry() expects the qty argument to be specified in the number of contracts.

The dynamic value you pass on each order is always interpreted in contracts regardless of what you set for default_qty_type in your strategy().

For additional context, default_qty_type and default_qty_value arguments are meant for static order sizes.

When you construct the alert message via JSON or Form with 'custom quantity', you can specify how WunderTrading should interpret the order size amountPerTrade with amountPerTradeType (at least at the time of writing this answer).
